title: Admissions Open for the 2027-28 Session
content: Kids Planet is now accepting applications for the 2027-28 academic session, Pre-Nursery through Class 8, English medium. Pre-Nursery reopens with this session. Walk in on any working day, call us on +91 94180 23454, or visit during office hours (Mon to Fri 9 AM to 3 PM, Saturday 9 AM to 1 PM).

title: Holi Holiday Notice
content: School will remain closed on 14 March 2026 for Holi. Classes resume on 16 March 2026. We wish all our families a colourful and joyful Holi.

title: Class 8 Farewell Ceremony
content: We gave our Class 8 graduates a warm farewell. To our wonderful students: every goodbye is the start of a great hello in your next chapter. Go out and write a bestseller, and shine as bright as the stars you are.

title: Republic Day Celebrations
content: Republic Day was marked with real feeling. Students performed songs, dances, and skits honouring the Constitution, and a fancy dress competition saw children dressed as national leaders and freedom fighters.

title: Winter Break Notice
content: School will remain closed for the winter break from 25 December 2025 to 2 January 2026. Classes resume on 3 January 2026. We wish all our families a warm and happy holiday season.

title: Art and Craft Exhibition Success
content: The Kids Planet Art and Craft Exhibition was a grand success. Students displayed handmade crafts, science models, paper lanterns, and artwork, and parents and neighbours turned out to appreciate their creativity.

title: Sports Day Results
content: Our Annual Sports Day drew a big turnout across races, relay, long jump, and team games. Congratulations to every winner and every participant. Each child who ran is a champion.
